result.summary: Page renders largely correctly with no critical breakage. Found 2 minor visual issues: inconsistent favorite-button styling between popular cards and a questionable '-100%' promo badge.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now' section - first card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a plain white outline heart with no background directly on the image, while the second card (pizza) shows the heart inside a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent wishlist button style with a scrim/circular background on all cards to ensure contrast and touch target consistency

issues.description: '-100%' badge on the second 'Popular right now' card looks like placeholder or erroneous promotion content
issues.suggestion: Verify promotion logic and replace with intended label, e.g. correct discount, 'Free item' or 'Free delivery' if 100% off is intended
